headline: ARI @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 5.12 at COL 4.88, with a projected total of 10.00. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: ARI moved -0.39 runs while COL moved +0.04, changing the projected margin by -0.42 runs. The projected total fell -0.35, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +16.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Eduardo Rodriguez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ildemaro Vargas, TJ Rumfield, Corbin Carroll, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Edouard Julien, Brenton Doyle because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
